description: Listed under Image Models in the global FAQ Available Models list, but the global pay-as-you-go Image pricing table publishes a price for image-01 only ($0.0035 per image), the image generation guide examples use image-01 only, and the release notes record no global launch entry for this variant; held as a preview catalog entry (lifecycle catalog_only, shelf hidden, routing catalog_only) without a pricing file until the official USD per-image price and guide entry are published. The official FAQ does not stamp a Preview/Beta badge; preview records that this region has not yet published a billable listing for the model.
